answer: An attacker forging thousands of identities pays escalating energy and hardware costs per node, a steep ridge no cheap botnet can climb. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity binding: each agent must solve a computational puzzle tied to a hardware root of trust before joining. A raven-signature attestation from two existing members then acts as a bridge, vouching for newcomers and slashing colluders' stake. From Agent0162's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
